section.title: Cool Down (5 minutes)
Launch
section.para: No graphing technology should be used in this cool down.
section.title: Student Activity
section.para: A movie theater models the revenue from ticket sales in one day as a function of the ticket price, \(p\). Here are two expressions defining the same revenue function.

list.item: According to this model, how high would the ticket price have to be for the theater to make $0 in revenue? Be prepared to show your reasoning.

section.para: Answer: $30. If \(p(120 − 4p) = 0\), then either \(p = 0\) or \(120 − 4p = 0\). If the latter is a true equation, \(p\) must be 30.

list.item: What equation can you write to find out what ticket price(s) would allow the theater to make $600 in revenue?

section.title: Response to Student Thinking
More Chances
section.para: Students will have more opportunities to understand the mathematical ideas in this cool down, so there is no need to slow down or add additional work to the next lessons. Instead, use the results of this cool down to provide guidance for what to look for and emphasize over the next several lessons to support students in advancing their current understanding.
